item.title: Academic Writing Skills
item.description:
Problem it solves

Many academic-writing prompts optimize only the final prose. This suite treats a paper as a research pipeline in which claims depend on sources, methods, analyses, and reporting choices. Agents must distinguish full-text verification, abstract or metadata verification, user-provided evidence, analysis output, inference, and unverified material.

What is included

  • 1 orchestrator skill + 12 specialist skills, with write-academic-paper as the multi-stage entry point;
  • Covers research-question definition, literature review, study design, data analysis, thesis and journal-article writing, defense, submission, peer-review revision, and research-integrity audit;
  • Built for ChatGPT and Codex, following the open Agent Skills folder format (each skill is a self-contained directory anchored by a SKILL.md).

Scope

The suite does not fabricate citations, DOIs, page numbers, data, or reviewer comments. It maintains claim–evidence alignment and weakens or flags unsupported claims. Discipline-specific reporting standards, terminology, and methods must be supplied as project context. It does not replace domain expertise, ethical approval, statistical review, source verification, or authorship accountability.
